KogaScript_KogaBeforeText:
Fwahahahaha!

I am KOGA of the
ELITE FOUR.

I live in shadows,
a ninja!

My intricate style
will confound and destroy you!

Confusion, sleep,
poison…

Prepare to be the
victim of my sin- ister technique!

Fwahahahaha!

#MON is not
merely about brute

force--you shall
see soon enough!
KogaScript_KogaBeatenText:
Ah!
You have proven your worth!
KogaScript_KogaDefeatText:
I subjected you to
everything I could muster.

But my efforts
failed. I must hone my skills.

Go on to the next
room, and put your abilities to test!
